title: Judicial Ethics Enforcement Act of 2025
latestAction: Referred to the House Committee on the Judiciary.
summary:
Judicial Ethics Enforcement Act of 2025

This bill establishes the Office of Inspector General for the Judicial Branch to investigate alleged misconduct in the judicial branch, including the Supreme Court; to conduct and supervise audits and investigations; and to prevent and detect waste, fraud, and abuse.
